name: Treal

facts.text: Treal: level 52, model 946 (the treant body), size 101, at about 335,000/314,900 on the western ledge of Altan Garran; respawn 80 seconds; a plain spawn with no script.

Writhing Death (Dolph): 'The Outland residents are attacked by a writhing, swarming mass.' Speak to Fedail (or Hedierna) in the outlander town of Altan Garran in Cothrom Gorge; kill Cronwort, Fuilwort and Tachtwort; return their remains to Fedail; kill Marfoirwort, 'the source of the worts'; bring the root to Treal.

Altan Garran (about 336,000/315,500 in Cothrom Gorge) is a walled outlander town of faction Outland Residents: Outland garda (49-53), conaitheoir (48-51), bardach (48-53) and asarlai (49-57), merchants (Egomas the smith, Halwyn, Paili, Noirin the enchanter, Forsa, Gearoidin the healer, Alastair and Luiseach Erea) and garran treants; its named are Fedail, Elnara Erea, Ulicia, Aodhnait, Ansol, Fachtna, Zinsya and Declan, all set aggressive (200) in the world data.
Living Server lore: Treal as the old treant the outlanders asked to build around; the root of Marfoirwort given to him to bury.

story:
Before there was a town on the eastern ledges of Cothrom Gorge there was a tree. Treal was old when the Long Pushing split the gorge, the outlanders of Altan Garran say, one of the forest's trees that leaned on the Root and felt the earth break under it, and he did not fall into the split: he walked back from the edge, the only tree that did, and stood on the ledge, and has stood there since. When the first outlanders came down from Domnann, an Erea asked him if they might build around him. He said yes. The town is a garran, a grove, because of him.

He speaks, rarely, and slowly, and only to the Ereas and to those who bring him something. The outlanders say the worts are the one thing he fears. He felt them begin, in the split below him, as a sickness in the soil, and he has felt them climb toward the town every summer since. He gave Elnara a cutting in the first bad year. He gave the town his windfalls for its walls. And he gave Fedail, long ago, the one instruction the outlanders have ever had from him: bring me the root of the thing at the head of the gorge.

So the strangers who go up the gorge to Marfoirwort and come back with its root bring it to Treal. Noirin the enchanter has watched him take it. He puts it down among his own roots, she says, and the ground closes over it, and for a while, a season or so, the worts nearest the town are slower, and the tendrils in the south wall come fewer. The outlanders think he is eating it. The Domnann wardens think he is holding it, as Elro holds the edge, and that one day he will not be able to. Treal has not said which.

He does not like strangers, any more than the town does. The ones who come to him without the root find out why the outlanders asked his leave before they built.
legend: Treal is a level 52 treant on the western ledge of Altan Garran and the hand-in for Writhing Death: bring him Marfoirwort's root and choose your reward. In the world data he is set aggressive like the rest of the town (Outland Residents), so whether a Hibernian can walk up and hand in is untested here. As a fight he is a plain 52 treant with an 80-second respawn, standing near the garran treants and Cuinn (65). Do not pull Cuinn with him by accident: Cuinn is the harder of the two. The outlanders say he buries what you bring him; be polite about it.
